Our Customer Experience team is committed to helping customers in their post-sales journey to deploy, adopt, and use Asana as both a technology product and a holistic way of working. We strive to help our customers, across geographies, industries, and functions, get off on the right foot, experience the most value out of the tool over time, and ultimately renew & grow their subscription.

We are looking for a senior leader for the Head of Digital & Scaled Customer Success.  In this role you will lead a team that designs and leads automated, data-driven programs to retain, engage, and grow large groups of smaller-tier customers without relying on one-on-one human management. You will build tech-touch strategies, manage digital engagement tools, and optimize operations to drive low-cost customer lifetime value.

title: Analytical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Data Science & Analytics team at Asana is how the company turns data into decisions — defining the questions that matter, surfacing the answers, and making sure insight is at the center of every critical product and business call. As a Senior Analytical Engineer, you sit at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, and you own the data foundations for a business domain end to end. Your mandate is to turn raw data into reliable, business-ready datasets that PMs, analysts, data scientists, and leaders actually trust and use — and to define the business logic and metric standards that make AI-powered self-serve trustworthy. You consume governed Silver tables and produce the Gold layer and semantic layer beneath Asana's most important metrics, dashboards, and Genie spaces. 

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, with the option to work from home on Wednesdays and, depending on the work and the teams you partner with, on Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office expectations.

What you'll achieve:

  • Own the Gold layer for a given business domain (e.g. PLG funnel, marketing attribution, revenue, NPI/AWM): Design and continuously improve the curated, dimensional data models that downstream dashboards, Genie spaces, and ELT reporting depend on.
  • Implement the canonical business logic behind your domain's core KPIs: Translate KPIs into governed, versioned metric marts that resolve "this number doesn't match" disputes for good.
  • Build and curate the semantic layer and Genie spaces that power self-serve in your domain: Author the metadata, documentation, and prompt/metric definitions that let stakeholders query governed data in plain language through Claude and Databricks Genie.
  • Own the metric dictionary for your domain: a single source of truth for what each metric means, who owns it, and where to find it. Partner with peers across DS&A to keep KPI definitions consistent where domains overlap.
  • Author data contracts and SLAs at the Silver→Gold boundary, partnering with Horizontal Data Engineering on the inputs you depend on, and owning data quality, freshness, and oncall for Gold/metric-mart failures in your domain.
  • Build and maintain certified, board-ready dashboards on governed Gold data, partnering with Data Science to translate insight requirements into trusted, reusable products rather than one-off builds.
  • Partner directly with Product & Business, Data Science, and Engineering to turn ambiguous, underspecified questions into scalable datasets — anticipating downstream reporting impacts before they become incidents, and raising the data-model quality bar across the domains you touch.

About you:

  • 4+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related analytics role, with a track record of independently owning the data models a team relies on for decisions.
  • Advanced SQL and strong data modeling fundamentals: dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and semantic layer design.
  • Hands-on experience with a transformation framework (dbt or equivalent), orchestration tooling (e.g. Airflow), version control (Git), and modern warehouse/lakehouse platforms (Databricks experience preferred).
  • Practical experience with data quality testing and observability, schema management and data contracts, and query/model performance and cost tuning.
  • Demonstrated domain fluency in at least one business area (e.g. PLG funnels, SLG pipeline, marketing attribution, Product telemetry, revenue/ARR) and the judgment to translate "I don't trust this number" into a specific, durable model fix.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills: requirement gathering, prioritization, documentation and enablement, driving alignment on metric definitions, and explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners.
  • Curiosity about AI-native analytics — NL2SQL, metadata/semantic layers for self-serve, and using tools like Claude and Genie to multiply your reach rather than replace rigor. Exposure to Unity Catalog, Looker/LookML, or reverse-ETL/activation (Salesforce, Marketo, Gainsight) is a plus.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy - apply today.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

  • Generous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and RSUs)
  • Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles ) 
  • Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med) 
  • Breakfast and lunch catering on the days that you work from the office
  • Vacation allowance
  • Career growth budget 
  • Home office setup budget 
  • Gym/Fitness card
  • Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot
  • Mental Health Support in Modern Health
  • Group life insurance
  • MacBooks with all necessary accessories

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 20,833 - 23,700 PLN gross per month (subject to all taxes and necessary deductions). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity and sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. title: Developer Advocate
descriptionHtml:
Developer Advocate

We’re looking for an experienced Developer Advocate in our SF Office. Our work informs teams at every level of the company and drives key roadmap decisions. Asana’s developer platform is growing, and we need a credible external voice in the developer and AI community. This role is about presence, trust, and distribution. You will represent Asana in the spaces where developers and builders actually live: on social media, at conferences, in forums, and through the content you create, and you will represent those developers at Asana.

We’re looking for the kind of person other developers follow because they consistently reinforce a trusted feedback loop between developers and the companies they’re building with. We need someone who can speak with real authority on agents and agentic workflows — and can articulate, better than anyone outside the company, how Asana creates value in an agentic world. If people in your corner of the developer community already look to you for approaches to AI, agentic workflows, and/or productivity tooling, we want to talk.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships with Marketing, Business Development, and Solutions Engineering to support partner integrations and growth.

The AI organization at Asana builds the platform and products that bring AI into how the world's teams work. title: Customer Success Manager, Scaled Accounts
descriptionHtml:

From high touch to scalable success, our goal is to deepen the usage of the whole work graph, resulting in delivering unmatched value with scalability and consistency. We strive to help all of our customers, across countries, industries, and functions, get off on the right foot and continue to get the most value out of Asana over time. We are looking for a Customer Success Manager, Scaled to partner with our growing customer base across Japan to drive adoption, retention, and satisfaction through time-bound engagements and scalable strategies.

This role is based in our Tokyo office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Thursday and one additional day of choice, which may be determined by your team. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on the two other weekdays they are not in office. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

descriptionHtml:

We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer with a passion for developer infrastructure. title: Social Media Lead
descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Social Media Lead to own Asana's voice across every channel our audience shows up in. We don't see social as a supporting channel; it's a direct lever for business impact.

This is a builder's role — hands-on and video-first. You'll set strategy, write briefs, and partner with our creative team. But you’ll also pick up a camera and design tools yourself, owning content creation, not just the calendar and the caption. You'll know the difference between a platform best practice and a genuine cultural moment, and you'll help define how Asana talks and shows up in storytelling as we evolve our narrative and stake our claim in the future-of-work conversation.

You'll be a strategic, thoughtful partner to peers across Marketing, Product, Comms, R&D, and our executive team, bringing your own point of view on what social should do next. That takes judgment: balancing a lot of competing asks while staying anchored to what's actually driving impact. This role reports to the Head of Global Communications.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Own Asana's social presence across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Reddit — developing and executing a content calendar that builds brand awareness, drives engagement, and supports pipeline and business goals.

  • Create and produce original content, video-first — short-form video, photography, graphics, and written copy — using AI tools as part of your own process for scripting, shooting, creating, and editing. Partner with our creative team on bigger productions, but be able to go from idea to a published video yourself when speed matters.

  • Concept and execute social campaigns tied to product launches, industry events, and key moments, ensuring every program lands with a consistent, compelling narrative.

  • Stay ahead of platform shifts and cultural moments — know what's genuine signal versus noise, and move fast when something is worth Asana's voice.

  • Be a proactive, strategic partner to peers — bringing stories, ideas, and a point of view to the table instead of waiting for a brief, and helping the broader team see social as a place to test and prove business impact, not just amplify what's already been decided.

  • Engage authentically with our community — customers, prospects, practitioners, and the wider future-of-work conversation — building our profile, telling our stories, and turning relationships into advocacy. Work closely with the PR and comms team to expertly handle issues and community feedback, if and when needed.

  • Monitor performance and translate analytics into strategy — use data to know what's actually working and why, and apply that judgment to prioritize across competing requests.

  • Steward the Asana brand across social, making sure every post reflects our core attributes.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • 8–10 years of experience in social media or digital marketing, ideally for a tech, AI-native, or B2B brand.

  • A track record of building differentiated social strategy and content — not just executing against an existing calendar.

  • Deep platform fluency across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Reddit — you understand distribution mechanics, community dynamics, and how a moment moves across channels.

  • Real hands-on production skill, video-first — you can shoot and edit a video yourself, not just direct someone else. Creation is part of the job.

  • Strong strategic instincts paired with a proactive mindset — you naturally bring ideas to the table and know how to be a thoughtful, trusted partner without losing your own point of view.

  • Sharp editorial instincts and a strong point of view on what makes content work; skilled writer with a real feel for tone, clarity, and craft.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Asana, security is foundational to our mission of helping humanity thrive by enabling the world's teams to work together effortlessly. Our security team protects Asana's employees, users, and customers by proactively addressing threats and fostering a culture of security throughout our product and operations.

We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to join our Product Security team in Vancouver. You'll be a key member of our security engineering team, partnering directly with product and infrastructure teams to ensure we design and ship secure software. You will be instrumental in scaling our security practices by building secure-by-default frameworks, eliminating entire classes of vulnerabilities, and championing a security-first mindset across our web, mobile, and AI-powered product surfaces.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.

What you'll achieve

  • Partner with product and engineering teams across the full software development lifecycle to ensure security is designed and built into Asana's products and platform.
  • Conduct security architecture reviews, threat modeling, and code reviews for new features and services.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain secure-by-default frameworks and libraries that empower engineering teams to build secure systems easily.
  • Build and maintain automated security tooling (static and dynamic analysis rules, custom SAST/DAST checks, and automated red-teaming) to scale security coverage without scaling headcount.
  • Identify and address AI-specific security risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool permissions, and abuse-resistant design in Asana's AI and agentic features.
  • Triage, investigate, and drive remediation of vulnerabilities from our bug bounty program, internal testing, and automated security tooling.
  • Influence engineering initiatives by conducting design and roadmap reviews, effectively communicating security constraints, and assisting teams in making informed trade-offs.
  • Investigate product security incidents as a subject matter expert, using logs and monitoring tools to contain, analyze, and drive resolution.
  • Evaluate and improve software supply chain security, including dependency management, SCA tooling, and third-party risk in the development pipeline.
  • Develop and deliver training to educate engineers on secure coding best practices and emerging threats.
  • Stay informed of industry trends, emerging threats, and best practices to ensure that Asana's security posture remains robust.
  • Collaborate with teammates and stakeholders to develop both short-term and long-term strategies for risk management.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with a security focus.
  • Strong software engineering background with experience in languages like Python, Javascript/Typescript or Scala.
  • Deep working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and common web application vulnerabilities such as XSS, CSRF, SSRF, and SQL injection.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML security concepts, including LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection and agentic attack surfaces.
  • Experience with security tools for static/dynamic analysis (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and vulnerability management.
  • Experience performing security design reviews and threat modeling for complex applications.
  • Excellent communication skills for collaborating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.

title: Corporate Account Executive, DACH
descriptionHtml:
We are entering a new era of work — one where AI agents collaborate alongside people to plan, act, and deliver outcomes at a scale and speed that wasn't possible before. At Asana, we call this Agentic Work Management: the orchestration of humans and AI agents toward shared goals, with full clarity on who is responsible for what, every step of the way. As a Corporate Account Executive, you will be at the forefront of this shift. You won't just be selling software — you'll be helping DACH organisations understand and solve their most pressing work management challenges, and guiding them toward a future where their teams and AI agents move together with purpose and trust.

This role is based in our Munich office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. title: Analytical Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
Analytical Engineering Manager

The Data Science & Analytics team at Asana is how the company turns data into decisions — defining the questions that matter, surfacing the answers, and making sure insight is at the center of every critical product and business call. As an Analytical Engineering Manager, you lead a team of Analytical Engineers who own the data foundations for the business: the Gold layer, canonical metrics, certified dashboards, and semantic layer that make Asana's most important numbers trustworthy, and that make AI-powered self-serve through Claude and Databricks Genie actually work. You sit at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, and you are accountable for whether business stakeholders trust the data in your team's domains and can answer their own questions without routing through your team.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. What you’ll achieve

  • Lead, grow, and develop a team of Analytical Engineers: Own hiring, coaching, performance, and career growth, and set a high bar for data-model quality and stakeholder trust.

  • Own the Gold layer and semantic-layer strategy across your team's domains (e.g. PLG, marketing, revenue, NPI/AWM): Your team is accountable for the curated data models, canonical metrics, dashboards, and Genie spaces the business depends on.

  • Treat every recurring insight as a product with an owner, a cadence, and an SLA: Build a catalog of trusted, versioned data products instead of one-off rebuilds.

  • Drive self-serve enablement: Prioritize the Gold tables, governed metric definitions, and metadata that make Claude + Databricks Genie trustworthy, so stakeholders can answer routine questions without coming to your team.

  • Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Infrastructure, and business teams to author data contracts and SLAs at the Silver→Gold boundary, and decide what to build, what to automate, and what to sunset.

  • Manage prioritization, run-rate, and cost as first-class metrics — making explicit build-vs-buy and stop-doing trade-offs rather than letting low-value work quietly erode the team's capacity.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • A track record of shipping trusted data products — governed Gold tables, canonical metrics, and semantic layers — that meaningfully reduced ad-hoc work and earned stakeholder trust.

descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Revenue Manager to support our global revenue accounting functions and collaborate with cross-functional teams. You will partner closely with Revenue Operations (Billings & Collections), Deal Desk, Business Technology, FP&A, Legal, Investor Relations, Sales, and other key stakeholders to influence and drive results for a wide array of business initiatives. In this role, you will oversee revenue recognition, contract reviews, and automation projects while supporting the maintenance of global revenue accounting policies and procedures. As part of our Finance team, you will contribute to the month-end close process, quarterly filings, and ad hoc requests, bringing technical ability and critical thinking to bridge the gap between operations, controls, and regulatory compliance.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. title: Renewals Manager
descriptionHtml:
Renewals Manager

As a member of our growing Renewals team, you will be instrumental in defining, testing, and scaling a renewals model that balances high-volume scale with top-down positioning across the Japan market. Based in our Tokyo office, you will partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders such as Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Finance, and Legal to ensure Asana customers are set up for continued success from their Asana investment. Your primary focus will be managing customer renewals to maximize retention, identify expansion opportunities, and drive a high degree of customer satisfaction. You will play a critical role in protecting and growing Asana's customer base by proactively managing renewal risk, demonstrating customer value, and driving timely contract execution.

This role is based in our Tokyo office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Thursday and one additional day of choice, which may be determined by your team. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on the two other weekdays they are not in office. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Own, drive, and lead the renewals process for customers in the Japan market, in collaboration with the account team, to preserve and improve customer contracts and relationships.
  • Actively engage with key decision-makers to understand customer requirements, demonstrate the value of Asana, and uncover roadblocks to ensure on-time renewals.
  • Negotiate and execute renewal contracts that align with customer goals in partnership with Finance and Legal.
  • Engage with at-risk customers and develop prescriptive strategies to mitigate potential churn and improve retention.
  • Communicate renewal risk clearly, take the lead in developing resolution strategies, and escalate wherever appropriate.
  • Discover and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities during the renewal process to maximize customer growth.
  • Maintain and report an accurate 90–120-day rolling forecast of renewals and proactively manage risks and opportunities within the forecast.
  • Track and contribute to key business outcomes, including Renewal Rate, Net Retention Rate (NRR), renewal attainment, and expansion.
  • Maintain accurate customer and renewal information in Salesforce and other relevant systems.
  • Assist with enhancing and improving systems, tools, and processes to increase team efficiency and scalability.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
  • Business-level fluency in Japanese and English.  
  • 2–5 years of experience in customer-facing SaaS roles, such as software/subscription renewals, account management, sales, customer success, or Deal Desk, with experience managing commercial conversations and customer relationships.
  • Experience managing commercial negotiations, discovery, value selling, and closing, with a track record of achieving business or revenue targets.
  • Comfortable working with technology and business systems such as Salesforce, Asana, and other SaaS tools, with the ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with clear written and verbal communication and the ability to manage a book of business effectively.
  • Strong collaborative spirit when partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and other cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals.
  • Ability to drive momentum and on-time renewals by connecting dots across large organizations, influencing stakeholders, and fostering collaboration.
  • Ability to understand customers’ business challenges and translate those needs into relevant, value-based solutions and recommendations.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple customer priorities, managing renewal risk, and maintaining high customer satisfaction.

title: Head of Research
descriptionHtml:
Head of Research 

Our work informs teams at every level of the company and drives key roadmap decisions. We partner with Product Design, Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering, as well as business and marketing teams, to get deep insights about our customer's behaviors and attitudes, translating them into actionable recommendations across the company. We think big about new areas, test developing concepts, and evaluate products and services once they’ve rolled out. We are looking for a Head of Product Research to lead a high-impact, mixed-method research practice spanning UX Research and Quantitative Market Research (QMR) at a pivotal moment in the company's evolution. In this role, you will build and lead a research function that generates actionable understanding of our users and their unmet needs, partnering across Product, Design, Engineering, and go-to-market teams to ensure insights are heard, applied, and reflected in strategic decisions.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. What you’ll achieve

  • Define and own the research agenda mapped to our highest-priority product and business questions, setting the standard for how insights translate into decisions from framing through synthesis, storytelling, and follow-through.
  • Champion a mixed-method approach—selecting qualitative, quantitative, or combined methods based on the strategic question—and serve as a thought partner to Design, Product, Data Science, and Engineering leadership.
  • Lead and unify a combined UX Research and Quantitative Market Research (QMR) function, ensuring coordinated methodology and a holistic view of user and market insight.
  • Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team across experience levels, cultivating a culture of craft, curiosity, accountability, and mentorship.
  • Lead the adoption and operational guidelines of modern AI tools to increase research velocity and coverage without sacrificing rigor.
  • Own the strategy and facilitation of our Beta program to build structured design partnerships with key customers that foster actionable feedback and co-development.
  • Define and maintain a company-wide usability framework embedded into the development process to ensure quality is continuously assessed.
  • Build scalable research operations across tooling, panel management, knowledge management, and recruitment infrastructure to prioritize resources effectively.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
  • Proven experience leading and scaling user research teams in a complex product environment, with deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative mixed-method research.
  • Demonstrated track record of connecting user and market insights directly to product strategy, roadmap decisions, and business outcomes.
  • Background navigating complex B2B or B2B2C contexts with multiple user types and cross-functional stakeholder audiences.

title: Technical Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Technical Consultant 

We are looking for a technical consultant who thrives at the intersection of code and customer. As a member of our Technical Services team, you’ll help our most strategic customers deeply integrate Asana into their ecosystems through custom automations, integrations, and strategic guidance. You’ll write code, influence architecture, and engage directly with IT and business leaders to deliver measurable impact through the Asana platform. This is a multi-faceted role—part solution architect, part developer, and part trusted advisor—ideal for someone who loves solving hard problems, building elegant technical solutions, and shaping the future of how organizations collaborate.

As a technical services consultant, you’ll work with our rapidly growing enterprise and strategic customer base, partnering with IT and business stakeholders to design and implement custom solutions using the Asana platform and third-party APIs. You’ll serve as a solution-oriented technical architect, empathetic customer advocate, and product expert—helping customers explore the art of the possible through data migrations, scripted automations, and custom integrations. You’ll advise customer-led engineering teams on how best to integrate Asana into their enterprise stack, and act as a liaison to the product team, offering invaluable feedback on our developer tools and platform. Internally, you’ll bring a unique, customer-centric technical perspective to teams across Asana. 

This role is based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. Along with most Asanas, you’ll work from this office in person on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your Talent Acquisition Partner will share more about the in-office requirements. 

What you’ll achieve

  • Become a subject matter expert on Asana’s product, APIs, and developer tools
  • Design and deliver scalable, customized solutions — including AI-augmented workflows — that integrate Asana into complex enterprise ecosystems
  • Lead post-sales delivery from kickoff through close — owning the project lifecycle, writing and reviewing code, and partnering with Customer Success Managers to ensure customers realize lasting value
  • Partner with Implementation Managers to coordinate project delivery, maintain momentum, and hold a high bar for customer experience throughout each engagement
  • Provide guidance on automation, integration, and extensibility within complex tech stacks
  • Evaluate technical feasibility of sophisticated customer use cases and drive alignment on solution strategy across cross-functional teams
  • Collaborate with internal teams to deliver a seamless end-to-end customer experience
  • Identify opportunities to improve technical services offerings and scale delivery practices
  • Represent the voice of the customer by sharing feedback with Product, Engineering, and Developer Relations

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

title: Software Engineer - AI Teammates Platform
descriptionHtml:
AI Teammates are Asana’s flagship AI innovation - autonomous agents embedded directly into enterprise workflows that reason, act, and proactively drive work forward. The AI Teammates Platform (AITP) team owns the execution engine and platform layer that makes these AI Teammates effective, reliable, and scalable.

We build the core systems behind agentic execution: model evaluation and rollouts, proactive detection of blocked work, execution quality infrastructure, tool orchestration, and the platform APIs that power AI across all of Asana engineering. Rather than building a monolithic feature, we build a composable foundation. If a Teammate reasons, acts, or autonomously improves - that’s us.

We’re looking for people who care deeply about customers and are passionate about building products that improve the way millions of teams work together. As a member of the team developing the software of a product-led company, you won’t just code — you will be an integral part of the entire product development process, from conception to post-launch reflection. Asana is helping teams become significantly more productive with our leading work management platform. You will be manifesting continuous improvements in their experience and helping us achieve our mission to enable all teams to work together effortlessly.

title: Customer Success Manager - Named Accounts
descriptionHtml:
Our Customer Success team is committed to helping customers maximize the value of Asana as both a technology platform and a holistic approach to collaboration. From high touch to scalable success, our goal is to deepen the usage of the whole work graph, resulting in delivering unmatched value with scalability and consistency. We strive to help all of our customers, across countries, industries, and functions, get off on the right foot and continue to get the most value out of Asana over time.

We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Customer Success Manager to help support and grow our largest and most strategic customers. As an Asana Enterprise CSM, you’ll guide the customer to deploy Asana successfully, adopt it widely across their organization, and ensure they continuously gain business value from our products and services. By engaging your customers using a consultative approach, you’ll position yourself as a preferred long-term strategic partner and serve as the trusted point of contact across their lifecycle. Equipped with the knowledge of what it takes for customers to succeed with Asana, you will serve as the voice of your customers cross-functionally, providing feedback to the Product team and broader business.

This role is based in our Tokyo office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Thursday and one additional day of choice, which may be determined by your team. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on the two other weekdays they are not in office. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Maintain ownership of a portfolio of strategic customers, weaving a web to develop new relationships while supporting existing teams to ultimately drive adoption and retention of Asana across their organization
  • Work with customers to understand their motivation, business drivers, strategic goals, and desired business outcomes; co-create joint customer impact plans that include success metrics, engagement and adoption strategy, timelines, communication, and plan to expand
  • Execute on all phases of the customer journey, including deployment design and execution, change management consulting, workflow design, business performance reviews, roadmap advisory, and renewal touch points
  • Develop and maintain an internal Champion Network across customer’s organization, facilitating workshops on best known practices
  • Analyze customer usage in internal data systems to identify, communicate, and act upon both risks and opportunities; proactively drive data-driven, account-focused campaigns to increase customer engagement and product adoption
  • Partner closely with Sales counterparts to build strategic account plans, nurture executive relationships, facilitate Executive Business Reviews, and identify expansion opportunities
  • Serve as the voice of your customers by surfacing key trends and insights back to our Product, Research, and business teams
  • Travel on-site up to 10% of the time, depending on customer needs

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making
  • 5+ years of experience in a Customer Success, Consulting, or Account Management role working with large, complex Enterprise-level accounts
  • Experience managing a book of high-value customer relationships with an ability to drive customer success and align within complex organizational structures, building trust with stakeholders from C-Suite Executives to day-to-day users
  • Customer-centric at your core with a devotion to ensuring customer success, adoption, and advocating for regional customer needs
  • Strong cross-functional collaborator with experience partnering with Account Executives or Partners to provide a high-quality, thoughtful customer experience
  • Self-motivated, proactive team player with a bias for action and ability to work effectively in an ambiguous, ever-changing environment
  • Driven, process-oriented mindset with the ability to effectively balance competing priorities and make decisions that best support the customer, team, and Asana
  • Strong understanding of the Japanese market
  • Fluency in Japanese is required; proficiency in English is preferred

title: Lead Product Manager, Enterprise Services Management
descriptionHtml:
Lead Product Manager, Enterprise Services Management 

The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products. You’ll take part in every type of product work here — from strategy to product to process improvements — conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.

Asana is building its next major business line: Service Management, powered by AI agents and tightly integrated with Asana’s Work Graph. This is a 0→1 opportunity to define how IT, HR, and Support teams resolve work, automate workflows, and connect tickets to projects in a modern, AI-native platform. We’re looking for a hands-on, highly entrepreneurial Lead PM who combines deep product craft with customer obsession, technical fluency, and strong go-to-market instincts. This person will help incubate a new business from scratch, partner directly with customers, and drive the product and GTM strategy required to build the next scalable product at Asana. 

This role is ideal for someone who loves ambiguity, builds quickly, learns from customers, and has experience shaping AI agentic workflows, IT/service automation tools, or adjacent enterprise SaaS products.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.   • Drive the 0→1 strategy and product vision by helping define the 3-year product strategy for Asana’s ESM business, including differentiation through AI agents, automations, and deep workflow integrations, and establishing Asana’s “right to win.
  • Partner deeply with customers by spending significant time validating pain points, co-developing workflows, and translating insights into clear MVP scope, an iterative roadmap, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build and launch an AI-native MVP, prioritizing a focused set of capabilities that solve real customer problems and collaborating closely with engineering, design, and UXR to build reliable, technical AI systems.
  • Drive cross-functional GTM by partnering with Sales, Channel, PMM, and CS on positioning, pricing, packaging, early lighthouse accounts, and working with channel partners to refine migration and onboarding experiences.
  • Operate with startup-level hustle and high velocity, breaking down ambiguous problems, shipping iteratively, validating quickly, learning from real usage, and staying scrappy and passionate about the 0→1 stage.

title: Lead Product Manager, Enterprise Services Management
descriptionHtml:
Lead Product Manager, Enterprise Services Management 

The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products. You’ll take part in every type of product work here — from strategy to product to process improvements — conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.

Asana is building its next major business line: Service Management, powered by AI agents and tightly integrated with Asana’s Work Graph. This is a 0→1 opportunity to define how IT, HR, and Support teams resolve work, automate workflows, and connect tickets to projects in a modern, AI-native platform. We’re looking for a hands-on, highly entrepreneurial Lead PM who combines deep product craft with customer obsession, technical fluency, and strong go-to-market instincts. This person will help incubate a new business from scratch, partner directly with customers, and drive the product and GTM strategy required to build the next scalable product at Asana. 

This role is ideal for someone who loves ambiguity, builds quickly, learns from customers, and has experience shaping AI agentic workflows, IT/service automation tools, or adjacent enterprise SaaS products.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Drive the 0→1 strategy and product vision by helping define the 3-year product strategy for Asana’s ESM business, including differentiation through AI agents, automations, and deep workflow integrations, and establishing Asana’s “right to win.
  • Partner deeply with customers by spending significant time validating pain points, co-developing workflows, and translating insights into clear MVP scope, an iterative roadmap, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build and launch an AI-native MVP, prioritizing a focused set of capabilities that solve real customer problems and collaborating closely with engineering, design, and UXR to build reliable, technical AI systems.
  • Drive cross-functional GTM by partnering with Sales, Channel, PMM, and CS on positioning, pricing, packaging, early lighthouse accounts, and working with channel partners to refine migration and onboarding experiences.
  • Operate with startup-level hustle and high velocity, breaking down ambiguous problems, shipping iteratively, validating quickly, learning from real usage, and staying scrappy and passionate about the 0→1 stage.


About you

  • 10+ years of Product Management experience, with demonstrated success building AI-driven platforms, automation systems, service workflows, or enterprise SaaS products; experience with multi-agent systems, LLM-powered workflows, or AI operations is a plus.
  • Strong 0→1 builder — you’ve built and scaled new products or incubations before and operate with urgency, resourcefulness, and creativity, pushing through ambiguity.
  • Technical systems thinker, comfortable going deep on architecture, flows, and tradeoffs with engineering, and able to reason about integrations, identity systems, workflow engines, and AI agent behavior.
  • Customer-centric, thriving in customer conversations and translating qualitative insights into sharp product decisions; energized by solving real operational pain.
  • Commercially and GTM savvy, equally comfortable in customer pitches, channel partner discussions, and pricing conversations as you are writing PRDs; skilled at positioning and selling into both mid-market and enterprise.
  • Communication and collaboration: exceptional communicator with crisp writing, clear storytelling, and the ability to persuade across engineering, design, sales, and executive stakeholders while bringing clarity to ambiguity.
  • Growth mindset and AI-first thinker, curious, adaptable, and eager to leverage emerging technologies to elevate product experiences and internal workflows.

title: Pricing Strategy Director
descriptionHtml:
Pricing Strategy Director

The Monetization Strategy team drives Asana’s pricing/packaging strategy and execution, helping our customers get more value out of our offerings and capturing a fair share of that value.  We work cross functionally to deliver impactful offerings for team productivity and collaboration.  We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work.  Our team works directly with Product/Engineering, Sales/Support, Customer Research, Marketing, Data Science, Finance and Operations to deliver valuable offerings to our customers.  You’ll take part in every type of product work here – from strategy to product to process improvements – conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.

As the Pricing Strategy Director, you’ll play an instrumental role in building and executing Asana’s product monetization strategy. Reporting to the Head of Pricing and Packaging, you will partner closely with Product, Sales/GTM, Marketing, Finance and operational leaders to launch and optimize our monetization strategy to drive sustainable revenue growth and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

This role can be based in our San Francisco or Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • With a focus on 1-2 business lines, drive the launch and optimization of our offerings: packaging, pricing model, price levels, and discount strategy.  Ensure it aligns with business objectives and strategies.
  • Maintain an informed perspective on the business by examining operating metrics, customer data, and market trends to spot potential monetization opportunities.  
  • Identify opportunities to drive impact in short term (1Q) and long term (1-3 yrs), develop strategies to seize those opportunities, and drive decision making and organizational alignment.
  • Design and execute detailed customer, product, competitor, and financial analyses to support the strategic recommendations. 
  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Product, Sales/CS, Finance, Operations) to create pricing and packaging recommendations, and confidently present these findings to the executive team (GMs, c-level, including CEO).
  • Orchestrate operational plan to implement monetization strategies, partnering closely with IT/Operations, Finance, Sales Enablement, and Deal Desk.
  • Participate in determining pricing KPIs. Track, monitor, and report on the effectiveness of implemented pricing and packaging changes as well as health of the business.

About you

  • 8+ years of pricing experience in strategy consulting / B2B software, which ideally includes 2+ years in pricing at enterprise-level SaaS companies
  • Proven experience in building pricing models, tools, and processes to optimize the pricing strategy
  • Robust analytical skills, including customer/competitor research and financial analysis to help drive data-driven decisions
  • Understanding of SaaS pricing, self-serve (product-led) and sales-lead go-to-market strategies, and customer buying behaviors (SMB and enterprise customers)

title: API Support Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As a Developer Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical partner for developers and customers integrating with the Asana platform. You’ll focus on API-related troubleshooting, developer workflows, and integration challenges - helping customers build reliably and confidently on top of our APIs. This is a hands-on role requiring basic programming skills, strong analytical skills, API debugging expertise, centered on delivering high-quality, developer-first support, combining technical depth with clear, empathetic communication.

In this role, you’ll work closely with customers to understand their use cases, diagnose complex technical issues, and advocate for improvements to our APIs and platform capabilities. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Developer Relations to drive scalable solutions, share developer insights, and improve the overall integration experience. You’ll thrive here if you’re technically curious, detail-oriented, and passionate about helping developers succeed through thoughtful, durable solutions—not just quick fixes.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. Along with most Asanas, you’ll work from this office in person on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your Talent Acquisition Partner will share more about the in-office requirements.

You will:

  • Provide technical support to customers, including debugging, troubleshooting and resolving API-related issues. Given the complexity and breadth of Asana's use across many industries, this is not a typical "question and answer" support role.
  • Triage and escalate API-related bugs and critical issues to R&D teams.
  • Support developers through email, our community forum, and live chat, ensuring they can successfully build on our platform.
  • Monitor internal Slack channels for urgent API support requests.
  • Collaborate with R&D teams to understand our API and influence improvements based on customer feedback.
  • Assist with API releases by communicating changelog updates and deprecation notices.
  • Review and approve third-party app integrations based on security and compliance guidelines.
  • Update developer documentation to clarify API usage and best practices.
  • Act as a liaison between API teams and Customer Support to ensure smooth communication about upcoming releases and changes.
  • Provide customer communication support during incidents involving API, webhooks, or event streams.

About you:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, developer support, application development or a related role.
  • Experience developing or integrating applications using APIs (including personal projects).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong understanding of REST API fundamentals (HTTP methods, JSON, pagination, query parameters, request bodies/responses).
  • Ability to write and debug scripts in JavaScript or Python to interact with APIs.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to interpret error messages and resolve API-related issues.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, and support teams.
  • Comfortable with and has experience working in fast-paced, agile, and ambiguous environments while working in a consultative manner with customers

Nice to have:

  • Understanding of OAuth concepts and authentication protocols.
  • Basic Git proficiency.
  • Familiarity with webhooks and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with command-line tools and basic Linux/Unix navigation.
  • Prior experience in developer relations, technical writing, or API advocacy.
  • Experience working with the Asana API or similar productivity tool APIs.
  • Experience with PowerBI and/or Tableau custom connectors
  • Public speaking, blogging, or content creation about technical topics.

What we offer

  • Generous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and generous Restricted Stock Unit for Asana Inc.)

title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Loading Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
LunaDb is Asana’s core reactive data loading platform, powering our GraphQL-like query model to deliver instantaneous updates across web, mobile, and external API platforms at a scale of billions of daily queries. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Data Loading Infrastructure team, you will lead the next chapter of LunaDb by driving stack modernization, challenging architectural assumptions, and building dependable, highly available distributed services. You will set technical direction, improve workload isolation and query performance, and partner closely with product engineering teams to ensure Asana remains fast, reliable, and scalable as we expand platform capabilities.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner.   • Define and execute a technical roadmap that improves scalability, reliability, developer productivity, and operational simplicity.
  • Design, build, and operate highly available distributed services, caching layers, and realtime data pipelines processing millions of events per second.
  • Advance query performance, cache invalidation, workload isolation, and resource efficiency while preserving data correctness across the platform.
  • Partner with product engineers to support new capabilities, making complex data access easier, faster, and more predictable.
  • Lead major initiatives through architecture, implementation, safe migration, rollout, and long-term production operations.
  • Mentor teammates, guide cross-team technical architecture, and raise the bar for system design, reliability, and engineering quality.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident investigations, and translate operational learnings into lasting improvements across tooling, automation, and infrastructure architecture.

About you

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed backend services.
  • 2+ years of experience building and scaling high-throughput data pipelines, relational/non-relational data stores, and realtime streaming systems.
  • Proven track record of operating mission-critical production systems and maintaining high reliability standards.

title: Copywriter
descriptionHtml:
The Asana Marketing team fuels business growth across revenue marketing, product marketing, brand, content, advertising, and lifecycle programs. We build campaigns, content, and experiences that drive impact at scale.

As our Senior Copywriter, you will be the definitive creative voice across Asana's Brand Creative team—shaping how the brand speaks across every channel, medium, and moment that matters.

This is a leaderful role as much as a writing role: you will define and steward our brand voice, set the standard for copy quality across the creative team, and bring language to life across campaigns, performance ads, sizzle reels, demo video scripts, and more. You will work at the intersection of strategy and craft—partnering closely with art directors, designers, producers, and cross-functional stakeholders—to translate briefs into work that is sharp, original, and unmistakably Asana. You will also be a teacher and force multiplier: codifying our voice in frameworks and guidelines others can apply, mentoring colleagues, and raising the bar for written communication across the Marketing organization.

You bring deep conviction and active curiosity to your work, including a genuine interest in how AI can augment the craft of writing. You know how to use these tools intelligently without sacrificing creative ownership, and you build workflows that help the team move faster without compromising quality or your own originality.

This role is based in our Vancouver, BC office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. Along with most Asanas, you’ll work from this office in person on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your Talent Acquisition Partner will share more about the in-office requirements. 

What you'll achieve

  • Define, steward, and evolve Asana's brand voice: building the guidelines, frameworks, and reference materials that make great writing scalable across Marketing surfaces
  • Serve as the hands-on writer and copy authority on campaigns, crafting language across formats, including: ads, landing pages, release communications, sizzle reels, demo video scripts, social content, and event materials
  • Lead copy on the highest-complexity, highest-visibility initiatives from brief through final delivery—managing feedback cycles, cross-functional input, and timelines along the way
  • Partner closely with art directors, designers, and producers to shape integrated creative, ensuring copy and design tell a coherent, compelling story together
  • Mentor and coach colleagues and cross-functional partners on what does and doesn't ring true to Asana's voice; develop resources and tools that make strong writing more accessible to the wider team
  • Drive alignment with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners, presenting creative rationale confidently and leading feedback conversations with clarity and conviction
  • Connect language and copy decisions to business outcomes, advocating for creative choices in terms of audience, objective, and measurable impact
  • Identify and implement AI-powered writing workflows that increase speed, efficiency, and creative range, while maintaining authorial voice and original thinking
  • Manage vendors and contract copywriters as needed, ensuring quality and brand consistency
  • Give and receive direct, constructive feedback through critique, and contribute to a creative culture where high standards and generosity coexist
  • Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with strong organizational judgment, moving projects reliably from brief to execution

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional creative projects from brief to delivery with minimal oversight
  • Experience working alongside designers and cross-functional stakeholders in a deeply integrated creative process

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Teammates Platform
descriptionHtml:
AI Teammates are Asana’s flagship AI innovation - autonomous agents embedded directly into enterprise workflows that reason, act, and proactively drive work forward. The AI Agents/Teammates Platform (AITP) team owns the execution engine and platform layer that makes Asana's AI Teammates and other AI Agents effective, reliable, and scalable. We build the core systems behind agentic execution: model evaluation and rollouts, proactive detection of blocked work, execution quality infrastructure, tool orchestration, and the platform APIs, events, harness and agentic memory that power AI across all of Asana engineering. Rather than building a monolithic feature, we build a composable foundation. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to drive key architectural initiatives, design performant agentic runtime systems, and help build a reliable foundation that scales to millions of users.

Location: San Francisco, office-centric hybrid (in office Monday, Tuesday, Thursday). Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What You’ll Achieve

  • Drive the technical design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of medium-to-large projects across the AI Teammates execution engine, tool orchestration, and platform APIs & events.
  • Architect and own composable platform foundations, harness, memory, partnering with product engineering teams to enable them to build agentic capabilities into their domains in a self-serve manner.
  • Design robust, extensible, and performant systems that support agentic execution, prompt-driven automation, tool integrations, and strict enterprise-grade reliability boundaries.
  • Solve complex technical problems across model evaluations, latency tuning, and cost optimization while balancing technical debt, execution risk, and direct business goals.
  • Move quickly by shipping in small increments, validating with real customer usage, evals, and metrics, and adjusting based on what the data shows rather than assumptions.
  • Anticipate customer and architectural risks early, breaking down complex agentic product visions into clear engineering milestones and actionable tasks.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of and accountability for outcomes, not just delivery, from design through production, quality, and customer impact.
  • Proactively identify gaps and opportunities, then propose and drive new features, platform capabilities, and re-architecture, backed by customer feedback and usage data.
  • Champion technical excellence, write high-leverage design docs, establish evaluation methodologies, and mentor engineers across levels to raise the engineering bar.
  • Partner closely with Product Management, Design, Data Science, and external model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) to define requirements and align technical direction.

About You

  • 6+ years building and running production distributed systems, microservices, or complex backend architectures.
  • A track record as Tech Lead or AoR owner, driving multi-contributor projects from ambiguity to delivery across teams and services.
  • High ownership and accountability: outcomes are yours, you follow through, and you raise risks early and openly.
  • Product and customer-first: you start from the customer problem, use feedback and data to shape direction, and bring ideas rather than waiting for specs. You understand how architecture and model behavior affect user trust, latency, and reliability.
  • Bias for action grounded in reality: you move fast and decide from customer feedback, production data, and eval results, and you know when a decision needs more rigor and when it can be reversed cheaply.
  • Strong design-doc skills and sound trade-off judgment (latency, cost, determinism, maintainability).
  • Hands-on experience or deep interest in LLMs, agentic patterns, eval pipelines, RAG, or real-time streaming.
  • A quick learner who ramps fast on new domains, codebases, and the AI landscape.

title: Digital & Scaled Customer Success Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Customer Success team is committed to helping customers maximize the value of Asana as both a technology platform and a holistic approach to collaboration. From high touch to scalable success, our goal is to deepen the usage of the whole work graph, resulting in delivering unmatched value with scalability and consistency. We strive to help all of our customers, across countries, industries, and functions, get off on the right foot and continue to get the most value out of Asana over time.

As a Digital & Scaled CS Program Manager, you will be a hands-on, technically adept owner of the build and execution layer of our Digital and Scaled CS program. Sitting at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Product Engineering, you will be the driving force behind turning digital CS strategy into working programs, maintained playbooks, enabled teams, and well-run vendor partnerships. Day to day, you will design and refine customer journeys, manage vendor relationships, and ensure every active program reflects both lifecycle best practices and real-world account reality.

This role is based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Digital Program Execution: Design, build, and refine campaigns and journey orchestrations in tools like Iterable, Outreach, Pocus, and Trig. Define lifecycle stages, trigger logic, and intervention sequencing while building and validating audiences in the CDP to ensure sound data quality before launch.
  • Program Governance & Quality: Maintain program governance through weekly checks, reviewing active journeys, flagging anomalies, and ensuring live programs reflect current business strategy.
  • Vendor Partnership Management: Own the day-to-day management of vendor partnerships, running standing cadences, tracking performance against KPIs, and handling escalations to align delivery with Scaled CS goals.
  • Playbooks & Enablement: Maintain and update playbooks to reflect changes in the Scaled motion. Build and review enablement materials to equip the Customer Success team to execute programs effectively and consistently.
  • Scaled Content Delivery: Plan and execute webinars and scaled content assets that deepen adoption and drive customer engagement, coordinating across Marketing and CS to align with overall strategy.
  • Commercial & Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate across Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Revenue Analytics, Marketing, Enterprise Technology, and Product Engineering to ensure programs reflect ground-level account reality and resolve data questions proactively.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
  • 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, CS Operations, or Marketing Automation, with at least 2 years building digital programs in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Proven ability to design, build, and run customer journey orchestrations in tools such as Iterable, Outreach, Gainsight, or similar, including lifecycle stage definition, trigger logic, and audience management.
  • Strong program build discipline with experience maintaining playbooks, managing governance processes, and ensuring quality before programs go live.
  • Commercial awareness with the ability to hold credible conversations with Sales regarding pipeline, account risk, and deal stages.
  • Proactive problem-solver with strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work independently on data questions without unnecessary escalation.

title: Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Asana, security is foundational to our mission of helping humanity thrive by enabling the world's teams to work together effortlessly. Our security team protects Asana's employees, users, and customers by proactively addressing threats and fostering a culture of security throughout our product and operations.

We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to join our Product Security team in Warsaw. You'll be a foundational member of the security presence in a key engineering hub, partnering directly with product and infrastructure teams to ensure we design and ship secure software. You will be instrumental in scaling our security practices by building secure-by-default frameworks, eliminating entire classes of vulnerabilities, and championing a security-first mindset across our web, mobile, and AI-powered product surfaces.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.

We offer a Contract of Employment (UoP) for our employees in Poland.

What you'll achieve

  • Partner with product and engineering teams across the full software development lifecycle to ensure security is designed and built into Asana's products and platform.
  • Conduct security architecture reviews, threat modeling, and code reviews for new features and services.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain secure-by-default frameworks and libraries that empower engineering teams to build secure systems easily.
  • Build and maintain automated security tooling (static and dynamic analysis rules, custom SAST/DAST checks, and automated red-teaming) to scale security coverage without scaling headcount.
  • Identify and address AI-specific security risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool permissions, and abuse-resistant design in Asana's AI and agentic features.
  • Triage, investigate, and drive remediation of vulnerabilities from our bug bounty program, internal testing, and automated security tooling.
  • Influence engineering initiatives by conducting design and roadmap reviews, effectively communicating security constraints, and assisting teams in making informed trade-offs.
  • Investigate product security incidents as a subject matter expert, using logs and monitoring tools to contain, analyze, and drive resolution.
  • Evaluate and improve software supply chain security, including dependency management, SCA tooling, and third-party risk in the development pipeline.
  • Develop and deliver training to educate engineers on secure coding best practices and emerging threats.
  • Stay informed of industry trends, emerging threats, and best practices to ensure that Asana's security posture remains robust.
  • Collaborate with teammates and stakeholders to develop both short-term and long-term strategies for risk management.

About you

  • 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with a security focus.
  • Strong software engineering background with experience in languages like Python, Javascript/Typescript or Scala.
  • Deep working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and common web application vulnerabilities such as XSS, CSRF, SSRF, and SQL injection.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML security concepts, including LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection and agentic attack surfaces.
  • Experience with security tools for static/dynamic analysis (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and vulnerability management.
  • Experience performing security design reviews and threat modeling for complex applications.
  • Excellent communication skills for collaborating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
  • A pragmatic and collaborative mindset, with a passion for building defenses against real-world attacks and enabling other engineers to do their best, most secure work.
  • Demonstrated curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

  • Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med)

title: Experience Researcher, PLG
descriptionHtml:
Our work informs teams at every level of Asana and drives key roadmap decisions. We partner with Product Design, Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering, as well as business and marketing teams, to develop valuable insights about customer behaviors and attitudes, translating them into actionable recommendations. We think deeply about new areas, help develop and test concepts, and improve products and services once they’ve rolled out. As a Senior Experience Researcher, you will be a strategic partner who not only executes high-impact research but also shapes the research culture to elevate our collective craft.

This role is based in our Vancouver office. Day to day collaboration is split roughly 50/50 between Vancouver teammates and San Francisco teammates. Locally, you will work closely with our PLG Adoption teams, specifically partnering with the AI Activations (AIA) and Conversion and Retention (CoRe) teams. Key local partners include Product Managers, Designers, and Engineering leads.

We operate with an office-centric hybrid schedule. In-office days are Monday, Tuesday and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you interview for this role, your recruiter will share more about in-office requirements.

In this role, you will help shape and scale Asana’s Product-Led Growth (PLG) self-serve business. We recently launched several major new products—including AI Teammates, a Meetings product, and Asana for Client Management (ACM). We are also preparing two more major product lines for launch, which will unlock entirely new workflows and use cases for our customers.  Historically, our growth relied on selling more seats or moving customers to higher tiers. Now, we have multiple new growth vectors, from AI credit consumption to these brand new product offerings. You will play a pivotal role in uncovering how to introduce users to these products, encourage users to try them, adopt them into their daily workflows, and deepen their usage over time.   

The Experience Researcher plays a key role in defining the product roadmap and influencing how our PLG adoption strategy evolves. 

What you’ll achieve

In your first 4-5 months, you will partner with Adoption teams on immediate Q4 roadmap priorities, building out the self-serve pathways to buy and adopt our newest products. Over time, your remit will expand as we roll out self-serve motions for additional products.

Be a strategic partner: Together with your cross-functional partners (Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science) you’ll uncover how to best introduce users to Asana’s new products, encourage users to try them out, drive adoption in daily workflows, and deepen usage over time.   Drive ACM self serve growth: Research how users discover Asana for Client Management (ACM), start using it, adopt advanced features, and expand its footprint across their organization.Uncover opportunities and pathways for how AI teammates, the Meetings product, and the client portal help customers extract more value from ACM and invite cross-functional collaboration.Lead research on new concepts: Lead research on new concepts: Drive exploratory and evaluative research for upcoming product additions, assessing whether new concepts and personalized experiences feel valuable enough to encourage user engagement and organic sharing.Build a foundation for future PLG offerings: Identify high-impact research needs to support the self-serve rollouts for the next two major product launches. Connect insights to business impact: Ensure research directly influences the roadmap to meet critical business metrics, supporting our goals for AI ARR growth, higher-LTV customers, and increased NRR.

About you

  • 6+ years of experience practicing UX Research for digital products, with a proven track record of leading large-scale projects. 
  • Strong proficiency in mixed-methods research, seamlessly combining qualitative deep-dives (contextual inquiry, prototype testing) with quantitative validation (survey design, behavioral data analysis) to triangulate insights and build high-confidence recommendations.
  • Mature product judgement with the ability to distill messy signal into clear, "low-polish" deliverables that drive immediate decision-making.
  • Strong organizational leadership and the ability to manage multiple complex workstreams while building deep trust and rapport with senior stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of interaction design and content hierarchy, allowing you to partner effectively with Design and Content Strategy to reduce friction and drive user action.
  • Persuasive communicator who can influence product strategy through storytelling and evidence-based recommendations.
  • Actively experimenting with AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making. We’re looking for researchers who can harness AI to extend and deepen the ways in which we develop insights and leverage them across the org.

What we’ll offer
