title: Developer Advocate
descriptionHtml:
Developer Advocate

We’re looking for an experienced Developer Advocate in our NYC Office. Our work informs teams at every level of the company and drives key roadmap decisions. Asana’s developer platform is growing, and we need a credible external voice in the developer and AI community. This role is about presence, trust, and distribution. You will represent Asana in the spaces where developers and builders actually live: on social media, at conferences, in forums, and through the content you create, and you will represent those developers at Asana.

We’re looking for the kind of person other developers follow because they consistently reinforce a trusted feedback loop between developers and the companies they’re building with. We need someone who can speak with real authority on agents and agentic workflows — and can articulate, better than anyone outside the company, how Asana creates value in an agentic world. If people in your corner of the developer community already look to you for approaches to AI, agentic workflows, and/or productivity tooling, we want to talk.

This role is based in our NYC office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Design and execute developer engagement strategies that drive adoption of Asana’s platform, APIs, and SDKs.
  • Author high-quality technical content, including sample apps, code tutorials, technical blog posts, and API documentation.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, IT and CIO Audiences
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Marketing Manager, IT & CIO Audiences

The Asana Product Marketing team fuels business growth and builds a brand customers love. We create campaigns and content that attract new accounts and inspire current ones to grow with us. We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own how Asana shows up to IT and digital transformation leaders. Your primary audiences are CIOs and IT Operations leaders.
You'll join the Audience Marketing team, the group responsible for how Asana speaks to the specific people and industries we sell into. These buyers are navigating tool consolidation, AI adoption, governance, and the shift to agentic workflows, and you'll turn deep knowledge of their world into technically credible messaging, content the field uses every day, and campaign themes that bring new logos into the pipeline. You'll own the narrative and the sales plays that the field uses for this persona, partnering across PMM, sales and product. You will report to the Director of Product Marketing, Audience Marketing.

What you’ll achieve

  • Own the audience strategy, messaging, and positioning for CIO, digital transformation, and IT Operations personas, aligned to Asana's broader positioning and revenue goals.
  • Become the expert on the trends driving stack change: AI adoption, tool sprawl and consolidation, security and governance and modernization.
  • Map how these buyers decide, including budget ownership, workflows, evaluation criteria, and the roles of technical influencers and executive sponsors.
  • Create technically credible content across the buyer journey, such as POVs, solution narratives, demos, executive briefings, and whitepapers.
  • Act as the subject matter expert across Asana's portfolio, partnering with Core PMMs to connect products to IT priorities, such as AI governance, tool consolidation, and scaling AI agents safely across the enterprise.
  • Equip the sales field for technical conversations with discovery guides, objection handling, competitive positioning, battlecards, and customer proof.
  • Shape new-logo acquisition campaigns in close partnership with Campaigns to generate net-new pipeline.
  • Represent the voice of the customer by bringing IT audience and market feedback into product and positioning decisions.
  • Create sales enablement and ensure the success of sales plays.

About you

  • 7+ years of experience in product marketing, audience marketing, or GTM at an enterprise software company.
  • Deep understanding of IT and technical buyers, including how stack, vendor, and budget decisions get made.
  • Experience in ITSM, developer tools, AI and automation platforms, or work management preferred.
  • Ability to explain complex technical and AI concepts clearly to both technical practitioners and executive audiences.
  • Comfortable in fast-moving categories where the narrative changes quarterly, with a point of view on where the market is heading.
  • Field-tested storyteller and writer who turns research into sales-ready content and pipeline-generating campaigns.

title: Fullstack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Product team builds features end-to-end. From designing our data models to implementing the subtle interaction behaviors that differentiate good software from great software. We work closely with UI designers and are supported by our infrastructure team. We aim to delight users with both large new features and smaller, daily product enhancements—thanks to our continuous deployment architecture. We want to create a superlative user experience, down to the smallest details.

Asana’s ecosystem includes a wide range of powerful apps that extend its capabilities and integrate it seamlessly into our users’ workflows. These apps help establish Asana as the shared collaboration infrastructure our customers use to get things done, spanning the full breadth of domains and departments. The Functional Integrations team in the Platform Area owns integrating Asana with the most valuable function-specific (think Operations, Marketing, or IT) tools, enabling experts on those teams to effectively share and communicate their work to the company as a whole.

We’re looking for full-stack engineers who care deeply about customers and are passionate about building products that improve the way millions of teams work together. As a member of the team developing the software of a product-led company, you won’t just code — you will be an integral part of the entire product development process, from conception to post-launch reflection.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.

Our employees in Poland are employed under a contract of employment.

What you’ll achieve

  • As a full-stack engineer, you get to build and own a broad swath of the product: everything from creating a compelling user interface down to creating efficient, flexible, and scalable back-end processing logic
  • Participate in every step of the product development process with an open and curious team, working cross-functionally with a product manager, designer, user researcher, and data scientist
  • Develop clean, beautiful code and leave it better than you found it
  • Experience growth and development through opportunities to stretch and learn
  • Be an early employee in our growing Warsaw office, contributing to a culture that keeps Asana's workplace balanced, performant, inclusive, transparent, and aligned with our values

About you

  • 6 or more years of full-stack experience working in large, well-maintained codebases building user-facing products (integration development preferred), with professional experience in Javascript/Typescript (React and Node.js) or Scala
  • Excellent communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional partners (e.g. PM, design) and cross-timezone with partner teams
  • Sound autonomous judgment when balancing moving quickly with producing quality, long-term maintainable code
  • Passionate about creating a superlative user experience and attentive to details
  • Appreciate productivity and care deeply about helping teams collaborate more effectively and efficiently, including your own
  • Excited to be a part of an inclusive culture where everyone brings the aspects of themselves to the workplace that they need to thrive
  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 31,900 PLN - 36,250 PLN (gross monthly). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.


We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

  • Generous, transparent and fair compensation system
  • Contract of Employment (and the option of  50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of  applicable roles ) 
  • Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med) 
  • Meals reimbursement on the days that you work from the office
  • Career growth budget 
  • Home office setup budget

title: Emerging Enterprise Account Executive, Healthcare
descriptionHtml:
Our sales team is committed to customer centricity by focusing on understanding and meeting the unique needs and aspirations of each customer. We prioritize delivering exceptional value through tailored solutions and strategic partnerships. By fostering a collaborative environment across all go-to-market functions, we engage in value selling, ensuring that every interaction enhances and maximizes the customer experience. We work closely with marketing, product, and customer success teams to ensure alignment and continuous improvement. Together, we identify and overcome technical, educational, and competitive challenges, driving long-term growth and customer satisfaction.

We’re seeking a high-energy, high-motor Account Executive to own a large book of mid-market and enterprise accounts within our healthcare segment. You’ll win new logos through disciplined prospecting while growing an install base of paying customers. This is a fast-moving seat: you’ll close a high volume of deals every quarter, from quick transactional wins to larger enterprise agreements, and you’ll learn to build the bigger deals over time. Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries is a plus, but it isn’t required.

This role is based in our New York, San Francisco, or Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you’re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Own and grow a large book of accounts, balancing new logo acquisition with expansion and renewals in a base of paying customers.
  • Build a smart territory plan: prioritize accounts by spend, expansion potential, product usage, and white space, and know where to move fast and where to go deep.
  • Drive consistent outbound activity across email, calls, and other channels, and use that activity to create a steady pipeline.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close, at high velocity and across deal sizes.
  • Grow smaller deals into larger, more strategic enterprise agreements over time.
  • Work through security, legal, privacy, and compliance reviews with customers in regulated environments.
  • Partner with Solutions Engineering, Sales Development, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Executive Sponsors to win deals and drive adoption.
  • Build trust with stakeholders at all levels, from day-to-day users to IT, security, and executive leaders.

About you

  • 5+ years of experience in a B2B closing sales role, with experience managing a large book of accounts in mid-market and/or enterprise sales. SaaS experience is a plus.
  • A high motor and a hunter mentality, with a disciplined approach to prospecting and a clear plan for how you cover a large territory week after week.
  • Comfortable in a transactional, high-volume environment, closing a range of deal sizes, and motivated to grow into larger deals.
  • A track record of high and consistent quota attainment.
  • Skilled at multi-threading and building trust with stakeholders across all levels of an organization.
  • Familiarity with working through security and compliance reviews in regulated markets (for example healthcare, financial services, or life sciences) is a plus. Healthcare experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • A self-starter who thrives on continuous learning and professional growth.
  • Curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to use them to work smarter.

At Asana, we’re committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you’re interested in this role and don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Customer Enablement Manager
descriptionHtml:
As a Customer Enablement Manager, you will partner with complex enterprise customers to transform how work gets done across their organizations. You will own a portfolio of strategic customers, providing a variety of enablement activities, including discovery, workflow consultation, change management, strategic enablement, and scalable education to accelerate adoption and measurable business outcomes.

You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, and Services to understand customer priorities, diagnose barriers to adoption, and recommend strategies that help organizations adopt new workflows and AI-enabled ways of working. As a senior individual contributor, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal partners, navigate complex stakeholder environments, and help shape repeatable approaches that strengthen Asana's broader Customer Enablement practice.

This role is West Coast based remote and is open to employees in Pacific or Mountain Standard time.

What you'll achieve

  • Strategic Trusted Advisory: Develop a deep understanding of customer business priorities, operating models, and ways of working. Lead discovery with complex stakeholders and translate customer challenges into clear recommendations for workflow, enablement, and adoption strategies that drive measurable business value.
  • Own Complex Customer Engagements: Independently manage complex enterprise engagements within your portfolio of strategic customers, from discovery and planning through delivery, measurement, and follow-through. Navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and multi-stakeholder environments while keeping engagements aligned to customer and account outcomes.
  • Drive Workflow and AI Transformation: Help customers rethink how work gets done by translating Asana and AI capabilities into practical, scalable use cases. Guide customers through the people, process, and behavior change required to successfully adopt new ways of working.
  • Executive and High-Impact Facilitation: Design and facilitate workflow consultations, strategic workshops, enablement programs, and executive-level conversations for audiences ranging from end users and champions to senior leaders. Adapt your approach based on customer maturity, organizational complexity, and desired outcomes.
  • Measure and Optimize Customer Impact: Use adoption, engagement, and efficacy data to assess whether enablement is driving meaningful behavior change and business outcomes. Identify trends, adjust engagement strategies, and use insights to strengthen customer plans and CEM programs.
  • Strengthen Customer Partnerships and Commercial Outcomes: Identify risks, expansion opportunities, and new use cases through your customer engagements. Partner with account teams to connect adoption and enablement strategies to retention, expansion, and long-term customer value.

About you

  • 6+ years of experience in customer enablement, customer success, strategic consulting, implementation, change management, professional services, or a related customer-facing role, ideally within SaaS.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex enterprise customer engagements that combine discovery, consultation, facilitation, and enablement to drive adoption, behavior change, or business transformation.
  • Strong consultative skills with the ability to uncover root causes, synthesize complex information, challenge assumptions constructively, and translate ambiguity into clear recommendations and action plans.
  • Experience engaging and influencing senior and executive stakeholders, including navigating competing priorities and building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to lead strategic conversations and high-impact sessions for audiences ranging from practitioners to executives.
  • Strong project and portfolio management skills, with a track record of independently managing multiple complex customer engagements and driving work forward without significant oversight.
  • Strong commercial acumen and an understanding of how adoption, customer value, retention, expansion, and organizational change are connected.
  • Strong product and technical curiosity, with the ability to quickly develop expertise in new technology and translate AI and workflow capabilities into meaningful customer use cases.
  • Data-informed and outcomes-oriented, with experience using customer signals and metrics to evaluate impact, identify risks, and adjust strategy.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners and contribute to improvements in programs, processes, playbooks, or customer strategy beyond your own individual accounts.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, exercising strong judgment, prioritization, and ownership.
  • Collaborative teammate who actively mentors others, shares expertise, and helps raise the quality and consistency of the broader team's work.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we'll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value, which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $147,000-167,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. title: Senior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Scientist

[Data] • [Vancouver, BC]

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help define Asana's growth strategy as users increasingly discover and adopt software through LLM interfaces like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. With millions of knowledge workers now starting their workday in conversational AI tools, we're at an inflection point in how productivity software reaches users. As part of the AI organization within Asana you'll leverage data to influence how we should build our agentic work management products. 

Asana's Data Science team helps us fulfill our mission by informing strategy, defining success metrics, and identifying new ways to deliver user value. Data scientists are at the crux of deepening our understanding of the customers and driving more business outcomes by leveraging experimentation, causal inference, statistical and machine learning techniques, and data storytelling.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner.   • Work closely with Product Managers, User Researchers (UXR), and Engineers to understand the needs of our agentic work management customers, employing data frameworks and methodologies to understand our user segments and identify levers for driving user engagement
  • Act as the data lead for specific AI features at Asana with product and engineering
  • Use data analysis and data storytelling to identify key product opportunities for the roadmap
  • Design experiments that measure product progress, and own key performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with fellow Data Scientists in the team to research, identify and disseminate best practices across teams
  • Work in a high-performance, dynamic team with a strong focus on velocity and software quality and learn about the upcoming field of AI-Optimization and how LLMs can help boost Asana’s value proposition.

  • 4-6 years of data science experience, with majority in growth-focused roles at B2B SaaS companies
  • 0→1 builder mentality. You've demonstrated the ability to thrive independently in ambiguous environments where you're inventing new playbooks rather than executing existing one
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership. You write crisply, tell clear stories, and can influence across product,engineering, design, partnerships, sales, and executive stakeholders. You bring clarity to ambiguity.
  • Experience with AI/ML products, LLM APIs, or third-party platform integrations. Strong preference for candidates who've worked with conversational AI or built features integrating ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical foundation with deep fluency in experimentation, A/B testing, pipeline management
  • Strategic business acumen to balance user experience with revenue objectives while translating emerging technology trends into actionable product strategy.
  • Genuine AI enthusiasm. You're curious, adaptable, and genuinely excited about how LLMs are transforming software discovery and adoption.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Korean Market)
descriptionHtml:
Enterprise Account Executive, Korea

[Singapore]

Korea is one of Asana's fastest-growing markets, and we're making a significant investment to accelerate that momentum. We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to own our go-to-market strategy for Korea, from defining where and how we win to closing the complex, multi-stakeholder deals that get us there.You'll be the face of Asana in market: building relationships with senior decision-makers in Korea's leading enterprises, drawing on your existing network and deep experience selling in Korea, shaping a channel and partner ecosystem that extends our reach, and positioning our AI work management platform, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash, as the way modern organizations coordinate human + AI work. You'll partner closely with regional and global colleagues across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Partnerships to turn Korea's growth into a durable, scalable business.

This role is based in our Singapore office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about in-office requirements.

What you'll achieve

  • Own the Korea go-to-market strategy, including account segmentation, target industries, territory planning, and pipeline generation, and translate it into a clear plan with measurable revenue outcomes.
  • Lead complex, multi-threaded enterprise sales cycles from first conversation to close, building consensus across business, IT, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
  • Build and scale relationships with channel and distribution partners in Korea, driving co-selling, joint pipeline, and partner-sourced revenue.
  • Leverage your relationships across Korea's enterprise and partner community to open doors at target accounts, accelerate early pipeline, and establish Asana as a credible, trusted brand in market.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to C-level and line-of-business leaders, translating Asana's value into business outcomes that resonate in the Korean market.
  • Position and sell Asana's AI portfolio, including AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash, helping customers identify high-impact use cases for human + AI collaboration.
  • Anticipate roadblocks and objections with foresight, crafting win-win solutions that ensure every stakeholder sees the value of Asana.
  • Partner seamlessly with SDRs, Field Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive long-term expansion.
  • Act as the voice of the Korean market internally, sharing customer and competitive insights with Product, Marketing, and regional leadership to inform localization and strategy.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making. 
  • Native or professional fluency in Korean and English, with a deep understanding of how enterprise buying works in the Korean market.
  • Direct experience selling into Korean enterprises, with a clear understanding of local buying culture, decision-making hierarchies, procurement processes, and relationship-driven sales cycles.
  • An established network in the Korean market, such as senior business and IT decision-makers, channel partners, resellers, and system integrators, that you can credibly leverage to build pipeline.

title: Product Manager, Coordinate
descriptionHtml:
The Product Management team drives Asana's product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. We're helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to join the team that keeps complex, interdependent work accurate as it changes. This team owns tasks and how they connect and stay in sync — including subtasks, dependencies, milestones, and the approvals that keep changes safe — across the views people plan from like the Task Pane, Board, Timeline, Gantt, and Project Overview. These mechanics are what let enterprise teams model their most complex initiatives directly in Asana, so decisions here carry real revenue and competitive weight. With Asana's recent launch of Agentic Work Management, where AI Teammates work alongside people on the same plan, this PM will help pioneer this new category — owning the strategy for keeping scheduling and task relationships trustworthy as agents, not just people, propose and make changes.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you'll achieve:

  • Set the strategy for how tasks connect and stay in sync as plans change — dependencies, durations, milestones, and the approval loops that keep updates safe — aligned with broader group goals
  • Drive end-to-end delivery of multi-month initiatives — from problem definition through launch — often defining work that lands on other teams' roadmaps and requires coordinating delivery across multiple teams, rather than owning a single piece of a larger initiative
  • Scope tight MVPs and prioritize rigorously, making sound decisions even without perfect information
  • Facilitate complex, multi-team alignment — our surfaces touch nearly every other team at Asana, so building consensus and driving cross-functional coordination is central to the role
  • Connect regularly with customers, using those insights to guide strategy, especially around how large and enterprise teams configure and scale their use of Asana
  • Mentor other product managers and help raise the bar on product craft across the team

About you:

  • 6-8 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of driving — not just contributing to — end-user features rather than purely internal or platform-only work
  • Experience shipping multi-month, end-to-end initiatives that require close coordination across multiple teams, including work that puts deliverables on other teams' roadmaps, where you owned the full arc from definition to delivery
  • You understand how complex, interdependent work actually gets planned and scheduled in large organizations — shifting timelines, messy dependency chains, and approval processes that vary team to team — and you've shaped product decisions around that complexity, not just built controls to manage it
  • Systems thinker: you're comfortable reasoning about how a change in one part of a platform affects adjacent and dependent surfaces, while still caring deeply about the individual, in-the-moment experience for the person using it
  • Strong cross-functional communicator: you can align multiple teams around a hard decision and keep execution moving even when consensus is hard to reach
  • A growth mindset: you seek out feedback, reflect, and actively mentor others
  • Background at a project or work management company or a mid-to-large enterprise SaaS company with complex scheduling or workflow needs is a plus, but not required

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

  • Generous, transparent and fair compensation system
  • Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles)
  • Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med)

  • Career growth budget 
  • Home office setup budget 
  • Gym/Fitness reimbursement
  • Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot
  • Mental Health Support in Modern Health
  • Group life insurance
  • MacBooks with all necessary accessories

title: Renewal Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Renewals team plays a crucial role in Asana's success by collaborating with both customers and multiple cross functional teams. As a Renewals team member, your main responsibility is to oversee client renewals, renew existing licenses, discover growth opportunities, identify/mitigate risk and ensure high customer satisfaction to minimize churn. This role involves understanding customer needs, building strong relationships, having strong negotiation skills and staying current on Asana’s pricing and packaging.

This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. What you’ll achieve:

  • Identify customer needs and demonstrate strong account management capabilities to drive on-time renewal closure.
  • Engage decision makers to identify customer requirements, budget, key stakeholders, approval processes, and uncover roadblocks.
  • Develop and deliver win/win negotiation strategies that maximise contract value while protecting and enhancing the customer relationship and the value they are realising from Asana
  • Maintain and report an accurate rolling 150-day forecast. Analyze renewal data to identify trends. 
  • Document all renewal steps, in accordance with Renewal Guidelines, clearly in SFDC/Clari systems 
  • Manage the quote-to-close processes for all renewals within an assigned territory. Create and negotiate strategic pricing and packaging proposals.

  • Identify risk early and navigate complex customer requests by effectively partnering with cross-functional groups such as Deal Desk, Sales Operations, Legal, Finance, Customer Success, and Sales Management to ensure customers realize value out of their investment in Asana.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Experienced in contract negotiations, value selling, discovery, and closing. Strong presentation skills and executive presence.  
  • Analytical Skills: Maintain a forecast and have an analytical mindset to analyze data and identify trends. 
  • Problem-solving Skills: Ability to identify and resolve issues related to renewals. 
  • Knowledge of Asana Products: Familiarity with work management and the Asana platform.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Analytics Engineer

The Data Science & Analytics team at Asana is how the company turns data into decisions — defining the questions that matter, surfacing the answers, and making sure insight is at the center of every critical product and business call. As a Senior Analytical Engineer, you sit at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, and you own the data foundations for a business domain end to end. Your mandate is to turn raw data into reliable, business-ready datasets that PMs, analysts, data scientists, and leaders actually trust and use — and to define the business logic and metric standards that make AI-powered self-serve trustworthy. You consume governed Silver tables and produce the Gold layer and semantic layer beneath Asana's most important metrics, dashboards, and Genie spaces. 

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements. 

What you’ll achieve

  • Own the Gold layer for a given business domain (e.g., PLG funnel, marketing attribution, revenue, NPI/AWM): Design and continuously improve the curated, dimensional data models that downstream dashboards, Genie spaces, and ELT reporting depend on.

  • Implement the canonical business logic behind your domain's core KPIs: Translate KPIs into governed, versioned metric marts that resolve "this number doesn't match" disputes for good.

  • Build and curate the semantic layer and Genie spaces that power self-serve in your domain: Author the metadata, documentation, and prompt/metric definitions that let stakeholders query governed data in plain language through Claude and Databricks Genie.

  • Own the metric dictionary for your domain: a single source of truth for what each metric means, who owns it, and where to find it. Partner with peers across DS&A to keep KPI definitions consistent where domains overlap.

  • Author data contracts and SLAs at the Silver→Gold boundary, partnering with Horizontal Data Engineering on the inputs you depend on, and owning data quality, freshness, and oncall for Gold/metric-mart failures in your domain.

  • Build and maintain certified, board-ready dashboards on governed Gold data, partnering with Data Science to translate insight requirements into trusted, reusable products rather than one-off builds.

  • Partner directly with Product & Business, Data Science, and Engineering to turn ambiguous, underspecified questions into scalable datasets — anticipating downstream reporting impacts before they become incidents, and raising the data-model quality bar across the domains you touch.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • 4+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related analytics role, with a track record of independently owning the data models a team relies on for decisions.

  • Advanced SQL and strong data modeling fundamentals: dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and semantic layer design.

  • Hands-on experience with a transformation framework (dbt or equivalent), orchestration tooling (e.g. Airflow), version control (Git), and modern warehouse/lakehouse platforms (Databricks experience preferred).

  • Practical experience with data quality testing and observability, schema management and data contracts, and query/model performance and cost tuning.

  • Demonstrated domain fluency in at least one business area (e.g. PLG funnels, SLG pipeline, marketing attribution, Product telemetry, revenue/ARR) and the judgment to translate "I don't trust this number" into a specific, durable model fix.

  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills: requirement gathering, prioritization, documentation and enablement, driving alignment on metric definitions, and explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners.

  • Curiosity about AI-native analytics — NL2SQL, metadata/semantic layers for self-serve, and using tools like Claude and Genie to multiply your reach rather than replace rigor. Exposure to Unity Catalog, Looker/LookML, or reverse-ETL/activation (Salesforce, Marketo, Gainsight) is a plus

     

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

  • Home office setup budget

  • Gym/Fitness card

  • Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot

  • Mental Health Support in Modern Health

  • Group life insurance

  • MacBooks with all necessary accessories

title: Customer Success Manager (AI Success Architect)
descriptionHtml:
Customers are no longer asking whether AI works—they’re asking what it will change about how they operate. As an AI Success Architect, you’ll help enterprise customers answer that question and turn Asana’s AI capabilities into measurable business results. You’ll own the post-sales relationship for a portfolio of ~50 enterprise accounts, acting as a strategic advisor with accountability for AI adoption, consumption, and commercial outcomes. In this advisory role, you’ll diagnose where AI changes how work gets done and guide the organizational change that makes it stick.

This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Serve as the trusted advisor and point of accountability for a portfolio of enterprise accounts across the customer lifecycle.

  • Build joint success plans that connect strategic customer goals to measurable results, leading business reviews focused on outcomes and value rather than just usage.

  • Diagnose customer workflows and map them to Asana’s AI capabilities (AI Studio, AI Teammates, and integrations built on the Model Context Protocol, or MCP) to replace manual effort and accelerate decision-making.

  • Assess how customers structure their work in Asana, guiding them to establish habits and governance that supply AI models with rich, consistent context.

  • Lead change management and enablement programs that build internal champions and ensure long-term, sustained adoption.

  • Track AI consumption and adoption against clear baselines and 30/60/90-day benchmarks, translating usage data into a compelling business story.

  • Identify expansion readiness for new AI use cases, products, or broader deployments, initiating conversations and partnering with the account team once validated.

  • Monitor account health, engagement, and sentiment to proactively mitigate risks well ahead of renewals.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, and Sales, while sharing structured customer insights with Product and Customer Success leadership.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • 5+ years of experience in customer success, strategic account management, or enterprise technology, with a track record of driving delivery and adoption for complex, high-value accounts.

  • Proven background managing enterprise relationships across both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Solid understanding of how AI agents function, workflow automation principles, and where AI provides substantial versus incremental impact.

  • Comfort discussing pricing, ROI, and commercial outcomes with senior executives, ideally within consumption-based models.

  • Strong competency in change management and program management across concurrent, long-term initiatives.

  • Effective communication skills across audiences, from executive presentations to tactical working sessions with operations teams.

  • Ability to navigate fast-paced, ambiguous environments with sound judgment.

title: Head of IT Systems Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Asana is hiring a Head of IT Systems Engineering to lead the team that powers how every Asana employee works. Reporting to the Head of IT, this San Francisco-based leader owns the strategy, architecture, and operations behind our SaaS productivity applications, corporate endpoints, identity, and user lifecycle, setting the standards and roadmap that keep every employee secure and productive. You will also influence the way Asana evaluates, adopts, and governs the tools and platforms our employees rely on. You will be responsible for the Client Platform Engineering, Application Engineering, and Identity & Integrations teams, who deliver this work. This role has one manager level report.

You ask good questions, are confident in not knowing everything, and would rather build with others than go it alone. You are crisp and detail oriented, but comfortable working outside the boundaries when the situation calls for it. You bring a proven record of success, a passion for technology, and, like us, you value hard work and fun in equal measure.

title: Senior Analyst, Channel Strategy & Operations
descriptionHtml:
The Channel and Ecosystems team is dedicated to accelerating Asana's growth and market reach through partnerships and fostering a thriving partner network. We build and nurture relationships with Channel Partners (VARs, Services Partners, Distributors, Systems Integrators), Technology Partners (ISVs, App Partners) and Strategic Alliances to support Asana customers across geographies through our partners' specialized expertise, consulting and technical capabilities. Our team collaborates closely with internal cross-functional teams to align partner efforts with company objectives and ensure that partners are engaged through comprehensive enablement, program support and resources.

As a Senior Analyst, Channel Strategy & Operations, you will be a core builder and strategic thought partner for our expanding partner business. Reporting to the Head of Channel Strategy & Operations, you will help build the data foundation that makes partner performance visible and trusted, improve operational processes, and lead strategic initiatives that drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue. title: Implementation Manager
descriptionHtml:
As Asana transitions from Collaborative Work Management (CWM) to Agentic Workflow Management (AWM), you will lead enterprise customers through that same transformation — helping them define what AI-powered work looks like for their organization, aligning stakeholders around a shared adoption plan, and driving measurable impact across their highest-value workflows. You will design and lead structured, time-bound engagements from onboarding through workflow launch, guiding teams and AI agents to execute work together seamlessly. Partnering closely with executive sponsors and frontline teams, you will navigate ambiguity, create operational clarity, and connect AI capabilities directly to meaningful business outcomes.

This role is based in our Munich office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements

What you’ll achieve

  • Lead structured onboarding and deployment engagements in partnership with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions, and R&D to drive adoption of Asana AI.

  • Align enterprise stakeholders on platform setup, workflow priorities, and shared success metrics while assessing workflow complexity to deliver early impact.

  • Document and hand off comprehensive implementation plans, capturing prioritized workflows, mitigation strategies for known risks, and clear milestones.

  • Guide customers end-to-end through workflow design, discovery, process mapping, configuration, and user acceptance testing with embedded Asana AI capabilities.

  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery across time-bound engagements, aligning workflow owners, IT, and business stakeholders from kickoff through training and launch.

  • Develop documentation and forward-looking roadmaps that define how customers scale Asana AI usage, including expansion recommendations.

  • Conduct recurring customer check-ins alongside account teams to assess workflow performance, adoption metrics, and identify new implementation opportunities.

  • Surface expansion signals to internal partners and establish repeatable delivery frameworks and best practices across the implementation team.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • Proven customer-facing implementation or consulting experience leading structured onboarding or deployment engagements within a SaaS company or consulting firm.

  • Experience deploying enterprise AI tools, AI-powered workflows, agent orchestration, or platform implementations involving data governance.

  • Demonstrated ability to guide customers through AI change management, building confidence and managing user adoption friction with empathy.

  • Track record of managing multiple enterprise workstreams and executive stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining timeline and milestone accountability.

  • Strong facilitation skills with the ability to translate complex customer feedback into actionable platform configurations and long-term adoption plans.

  • Bias toward action with the ability to navigate ambiguous environments, make sound decisions with incomplete data, and establish operational momentum.

  • Clear, structured communicator skilled at translating complex technical workflows into actionable future states for executive sponsors, workflow owners, and cross-functional teams.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between €104,000 - €132,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

  • Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits

  • Career coaching & support

  • Inclusive family building benefits

  • Long-term savings or retirement plans

  • In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

#LI-Hybrid

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Technical Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
テクニカルアカウントマネージャー (Technical Account Manager)

Asanaのテクニカルアカウントマネジャー（Technical Account Manager: TAM）は、顧客が日々の業務において「明瞭さ（Clarity）」を見出し、Asanaを活用して成果を上げることを支援します。TAMはAsanaのエキスパートであり、顧客の成功に情熱を注ぐ生産性のプロフェッショナルです。顧客からの質問、機能リクエスト、インシデント報告に対応し、中長期的な視点でのAsana活用のためのベストプラクティスを提供します。また、Asana社内では顧客の声を製品開発に反映させるための代弁者となり、製品開発チームと対話します。TAMの成功指標は「顧客の成功」であり、顧客への深い共感（Empathy）を通じてそれを実現します。

AsanaのTAMとして、あなたは大規模かつ複雑な要件を持つエンタープライズ顧客に対し、戦略的な技術アドバイザーとしてサポートを提供します。顧客のステークホルダーと深く連携し、技術的なイネーブルメント（定着化）を推進し、継続的な利用を確実にするとともに、Asanaの機能を顧客の長期的目標に合致させます。この役割は、強力な技術的適性、卓越した顧客への共感力、そして社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込む影響力が求められる、クロスファンクショナルなポジションです。

【勤務地・働き方】

このポジションはAsana Japanの技術本部長にレポートします。

私たちは、居住地に関わらず最適な人材をお迎えしたいと考えています。そのため、ご本人の状況に合わせて以下のいずれかの働き方を用意しています。

  • 関東圏にお住まいの方： 東京オフィスを拠点とした、オフィス中心のハイブリッドスケジュール（原則 月・火・木曜出社）となります。

  • 関東圏以外にお住まいの方（日本国内）： リモートワークでの勤務が可能です。ただし、チームビルディングや重要会議のため、月1〜2回程度、東京オフィスへの出社をお願いしています（詳細は面接時にご案内します）。

なお、重要な会議やオンサイト支援など、状況に応じて顧客先への訪問や国内出張が発生する場合があります。

【主な業務内容】

  • 顧客への技術的アドバイザリーとベストプラクティスの提供

  • エンタープライズ顧客の導入後における「技術的な成功（Technical Success）」に責任を持ち、Asana活用拡大の主要な技術アドバイザーおよびパートナーとして機能する。

  • Asana API、サードパーティサービスとの連携、認証（SAML/SCIM）、クラウドセキュリティおよび管理者ガバナンスに関するベストプラクティスを、顧客の環境や目標に合わせて設計・提案する。

  • 顧客のシステムアーキテクチャ、ビジネス上の優先順位、技術構成に関する深い知識を維持し、ニーズを先読みした提案を行う。

  • 顧客の健全性維持とリスク管理

  • 顧客との定期的なコミュニケーションや技術レビューを通じて顧客におけるAsana利活用にプロアクティブに関与し、製品価値の定着と継続的な利用を促進する。

  • セールス、カスタマーサクセスマネージャ（CSM）と共同で利用パターンやエンゲージメント傾向からヘルススコアを監視し、リスクの早期発見や、利用拡大・再エンゲージメントの機会を特定する。

  • 各種エスカレーション、移行プロジェクト、重大インシデント対応を社内各部門と連携して主導し、予防・早期検知・透明性のあるコミュニケーションを通じてリスクを最小化する。

  • 社内連携と製品へのフィードバック

  • 社内の技術ナレッジの標準化を推進し、再現性のあるベストプラクティスを策定・共有することで、チーム全体の提案力向上に貢献する。

  • セールス、サポート、プロダクト、エンジニアリングチームと緊密に連携し、統一された顧客体験を提供する。

  • 顧客の声を代弁し、実際のユースケースや課題に基づいたフィードバックを行うことで、製品ロードマップへ影響を与える。

【応募資格】

  • 経験とドメイン知識

  • SaaS業界における、顧客対面型の技術的役割（TAM、ソリューションエンジニア、導入コンサルタントなど）での5年以上の経験。

  • ワークフロー、自動化、ビジネスプロセス管理（BPM）など、業務プロセスに関わるSaaS・ソフトウェアを直接取り扱った経験。

  • ※インフラやセキュリティ領域専業ではなく、ビジネスロジックやアプリケーション層の課題解決に関わった経験を重視します。

  • 大規模なエンタープライズ顧客の複雑なステークホルダー管理を行い、プロジェクトを成功に導いた実績。

  • 技術的専門性

  • API、システム連携、認証プロトコル（SAML, SCIM）、および技術アーキテクチャについて、顧客と自信を持って議論できる技術的知見。

  • SaaSインフラ、セキュリティ基準、エンタープライズIT環境に関する広範な理解。

  • 顧客の技術的な課題や質問を素早く理解し、複雑な概念を噛み砕いて解決策を提示する能力。

  • コミュニケーションと言語能力

  • 日本語によるネイティブレベルのコミュニケーション能力（口頭および記述）。

  • 英語力は必須ではありませんが、英語の読み書きに抵抗がないこと（会社が用意するAIツールを使用しての対応でも可）

  • 優れたドキュメンテーション能力、ファシリテーション能力、プレゼンテーション能力。

  • 技術的な内容を、現場の運用担当者から経営層（非技術者）まで、相手に合わせて分かりやすく伝える能力。

  • マインドセットと姿勢

  • 標準化へのリーダーシップ：属人化を防ぎ、チーム全体の成果を最大化するために、ナレッジの共有やベストプラクティスの標準化（Playbook作成など）を率先して推進できること。

  • プロセス主導型： すべての顧客に標準化された極めてポジティブな体験を提供するためのプロセスを作成、実装、改善することへの強い意欲。

  • 学習意欲： 新しい製品機能や技術トラブルシューティング、AIツールなどの新技術を自ら学び、業務の効率化や顧客への価値提供に活かす姿勢。

  • プロアクティブな行動とコミュニケーション： 常に先回りして行動を起こし、かつ透明性の高い発信を行うことで、周囲からの信頼を確実に獲得できること。

Technical Account Manager

Our Technical Account Management (TAM) team helps customers find clarity in their work and get results with Asana. TAMs are Asana experts and productivity partners who are passionate about investing in our customers’ success. We help customers resolve technical inquiries, guide architectural decisions, and educate them on best practices for long-term scalability. Within the organization, we amplify our customers’ voices in product development and maintain an active dialogue with our product and engineering teams.

As a Technical Account Manager at Asana, you’ll act as a strategic technical advisor to our largest and most complex enterprise customers. You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders to drive technical enablement, ensure sustained adoption, and align Asana’s capabilities with their organizational goals. This is a cross-functional role requiring strong technical acumen, customer empathy, and the ability to influence both internal and external stakeholders.

This role can either be fully remote depending on where you live in Japan, or based in our Tokyo office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Thursday and one additional day of choice, which may be determined by your team. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on the two other weekdays they are not in office. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements. Occasional domestic travel to customer sites may be required for key meetings and on-site support.

What you’ll achieve

  • Own post-sales technical relationships for enterprise customers, serving as their primary advisor and partner as they scale on Asana.

  • Deliver best-practice guidance on Asana APIs, third-party integrations, authentication (SAML/SCIM), cloud security, and administrative governance tailored to each customer’s technical environment.

  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of customer technical architecture and business priorities to proactively anticipate and solve technical challenges.

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to monitor customer health, track engagement trends, and identify risk early while uncovering expansion opportunities.

  • Coordinate technical escalations, migration projects, and critical incidents in partnership with cross-functional teams, ensuring clear communication and prompt resolution.

  • Standardize technical knowledge across the team by developing reproducible best practices, documentation, and playbooks.

  • Collaborate with Support, Product, and Engineering to deliver a unified customer experience and advocate for customer needs on the product roadmap.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing consultative technical role (such as TAM, Solutions Engineer, or Implementation Consultant) within the SaaS space.

  • Background in workflow management, automation, or business process management (BPM) software, with a focus on solving problems in the application layer and business logic.

  • Proven track record partnering with and influencing senior stakeholders in large enterprise environments.

  • Strong technical acumen across APIs, system integrations, enterprise authentication protocols (SAML, SCIM), and cloud IT infrastructure.

  • Native-level fluency in Japanese (verbal and written), with professional working proficiency in written English (reading and writing, with company-provided AI translation tools welcome).

  • Strong presentation, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Process-driven approach with a focus on establishing scalable playbooks and continuous operational improvement.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. title: Lead Product Manager, APIs and MCP
descriptionHtml:
The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs into products that help teams work together and see the larger purpose behind their work. As AI agents become part of how work gets done, we’re building new ways for people, developers, and agents to collaborate through Asana’s Work Graph.

We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to lead product strategy for Asana’s APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. You’ll help external developers and AI agents understand and act on the work teams manage in Asana—from tasks and projects to the goals, ownership, and dependencies that connect them. You’ll shape a platform that makes these workflows useful, reliable, and secure, balancing developer experience with the controls enterprise customers need. You’re a technical product leader who can reason deeply about systems, turn emerging customer needs into a focused roadmap, and bring engineering, design, research, and go-to-market partners together to deliver meaningful outcomes.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Own the product vision and prioritized roadmap for Asana’s APIs and MCP server, connecting developer and customer needs to Asana’s broader product strategy.
  • Enable external developers and agents to complete valuable workflows in Asana, and improve the journey from discovering Asana's APIs and MCP tools to completing a first successful workflow.
  • Expand access to Work Graph capabilities in partnership with the teams that own them.
  • Reduce friction in documentation, authorization, and everyday use.
  • Partner closely with engineering to improve platform reliability, performance, and compatibility as API and MCP capabilities evolve. 
  • Use customer feedback, evaluations, and success measures (adoption, workflow completion, reliability, and time to value) to identify where workflows fail and prioritize improvements.
  • Work with security and enterprise product teams to make agent access trustworthy. Define clear permissions, administrative controls, and accountability for actions taken by agents.
  • Lead initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration across multiple teams. Measure success through adoption, workflow completion, reliability, and time to value.

About you

  • 6-8 years of product management experience, with a track record of launching and growing products in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or developer platforms.
  • Experience shaping technical platform or developer-facing products, including APIs and MCP servers, and connecting API and infrastructure decisions to real customer problems and business outcomes.
  • Technical fluency and systems thinking. You can reason about APIs, authentication, permissions, dependencies, and failure modes, and translate technical protocols into clear end-to-end user flows. You have experience designing API contracts, managing versioning and backward compatibility, and owning SDKs and developer documentation.
  • Strong product judgment. You can navigate ambiguity, identify the core problem, and turn a broad opportunity into a focused, sequenced roadmap.
  • A customer-centered, analytical approach. You seek out developer and user feedback, define meaningful success measures, and use evidence to guide prioritization and iteration.
  • Proven ability to lead end-to-end product delivery and align multiple teams around difficult decisions. You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners and keep execution moving across dependencies.
  • Experience mentoring and developing other product managers.
  • Preferred: bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Customer Success Manager (AI Success Architect)
descriptionHtml:
Customers are no longer asking whether AI works—they’re asking what it will change about how they operate. As an AI Success Architect, you’ll help enterprise customers answer that question and turn Asana’s AI capabilities into measurable business results. You’ll own the post-sales relationship for a portfolio of ~50 enterprise accounts, acting as a strategic advisor with accountability for AI adoption, consumption, and commercial outcomes. In this advisory role, you’ll diagnose where AI changes how work gets done and guide the organizational change that makes it stick.

This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Serve as the trusted advisor and point of accountability for a portfolio of enterprise accounts across the customer lifecycle.

  • Build joint success plans that connect strategic customer goals to measurable results, leading business reviews focused on outcomes and value rather than just usage.

  • Diagnose customer workflows and map them to Asana’s AI capabilities (AI Studio, AI Teammates, and integrations built on the Model Context Protocol, or MCP) to replace manual effort and accelerate decision-making.

  • Assess how customers structure their work in Asana, guiding them to establish habits and governance that supply AI models with rich, consistent context.

  • Lead change management and enablement programs that build internal champions and ensure long-term, sustained adoption.

  • Track AI consumption and adoption against clear baselines and 30/60/90-day benchmarks, translating usage data into a compelling business story.

  • Identify expansion readiness for new AI use cases, products, or broader deployments, initiating conversations and partnering with the account team once validated.

  • Monitor account health, engagement, and sentiment to proactively mitigate risks well ahead of renewals.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, and Sales, while sharing structured customer insights with Product and Customer Success leadership.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • 5+ years of experience in customer success, strategic account management, or enterprise technology, with a track record of driving delivery and adoption for complex, high-value accounts.

  • Proven background managing enterprise relationships across both technical and business stakeholders.

  • Solid understanding of how AI agents function, workflow automation principles, and where AI provides substantial versus incremental impact.

  • Comfort discussing pricing, ROI, and commercial outcomes with senior executives, ideally within consumption-based models.

  • Strong competency in change management and program management across concurrent, long-term initiatives.

  • Effective communication skills across audiences, from executive presentations to tactical working sessions with operations teams.

  • Ability to navigate fast-paced, ambiguous environments with sound judgment.

  • Willingness to travel up to 20% to customer sites as needed.

  • Experience with enterprise AI, automation, or workflow platforms (or familiarity with MCP) is a plus.

title: Security Risk Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Asana, security is foundational to our mission of helping teams work together effortlessly. Our security team protects Asana's employees, users, and customers by proactively addressing threats, ensuring compliance, and fostering a culture of security throughout our product and operations.

As the Security Risk Engineer, you will own Asana's internal security risk management program end-to-end. This is a senior role for someone who goes beyond frameworks and checklists — you will engineer the quantitative and automated foundations that let Asana continuously measure and make confident decisions about security risk. You'll build the systems and processes that make risk scalable, not just the policies that describe it, and serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership.

This role is based in our Vancouver, BC office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements

What you'll achieve

  • Own Asana's security risk management program: Design and continuously mature a quantitative risk framework — including risk scoring methodologies, likelihood and impact modeling, and risk appetite thresholds — that enables consistent, data-driven risk decisions across the organization.
  • Build and maintain a living risk register: Own Asana's central security risk register, developing KRIs, tracking trends over time, and driving accountability for risk treatment and remediation with business and technical owners.
  • Automate risk identification and monitoring: Design and implement automated data pipelines and integrations that continuously surface security risks — pulling signals from vulnerability scanners, cloud security tooling, SIEMs, and third-party risk sources — so Asana's risk posture is always current and not dependent on manual review cycles.
  • Deliver quantitative risk reporting: Develop executive-level dashboards that communicate security risk in business terms — probability, potential impact, cost of control vs. cost of breach, and residual risk exposure — to inform investment and prioritization decisions.
  • Partner cross-functionally on risk: Act as the primary security risk partner to Legal, Privacy, Finance, and Engineering. Influence security investment decisions and build a culture of risk awareness across the company.

About you

  • 7+ years of experience in information security with a strong focus on security risk management and GRC.
  • Demonstrated experience building or leading a security risk management program — not just contributing to one.
  • Hands-on experience with quantitative risk methodologies such as FAIR, risk scoring models, or statistical risk analysis. You back up risk ratings with numbers, not just color codes.
  • Hands-on experience scripting or building automation to integrate security tooling, build data pipelines, or automate risk monitoring — you've built things, not just directed others to build them.Deep knowledge of security frameworks including NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-30, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and FedRAMP.
  • Proven ability to develop risk metrics, KRIs, and executive-level reporting that drives decision-making.
  • Strong understanding of cloud environments and SaaS architecture — enough to have credible risk conversations with technical teams.
  • Excellent communicator who can translate technical risk findings for both engineering teams and C-suite stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity and decision-making.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we'll offer

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $158,000–$180,000 CAD. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include equity and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more.

title: Staff Product Designer, AI
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer who is excited to design the future of teamwork at the exact moment it is being reinvented. You’ll join Asana’s AI Design team to craft the experiences where AI does real work alongside people—from agents that take on tasks and AI-recommended workflows to the enterprise controls that build trust. Many of the interaction patterns we need don’t exist yet, giving you the opportunity to invent, ship, and scale them while setting the craft bar across our AI products and platform teams.

We design the future of teamwork. Asana has a bold, ambitious mission: help humanity thrive by enabling the world’s teams to work together effortlessly. Our design team is at the heart of that mission. Asana Design is an inclusive and collaborative community made up of a diverse group of designers from different backgrounds (product, brand and content design, design operations, producers, motion design, film, copywriting). We love combining research, data insights, and peer feedback into a human-centered design process to produce designs that are core to the power of our applications. We partner with people across Asana to create our product, shape our brand, and drive greater impact through design—solving challenges, creating experiences that customers love, and taking the time to get weird and have fun along the way. We believe every designer should have the opportunity to grow and learn by utilizing their strengths and nurturing their interests.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Lead the design of end-to-end experiences for Asana’s AI products, taking ambiguous, high-stakes problems from first framing to polished, shipped details.
  • Define the interaction language for how people delegate to, steer, review, and trust AI in Asana—including how agents show their work, ask for input, explain their reasoning, recover from mistakes, and hand work back to people.
  • Champion product excellence by raising the bar for interaction and visual craft so powerful AI capabilities feel clear, calm, and unmistakably Asana, while contributing AI-native patterns and components to our design system.
  • Turn system and technical complexity into simple, dependable experiences by partnering with engineering and product to understand how models, tools, context, and permissions work, and designing for those realities.
  • Treat AI as a design material by prototyping with real models, writing and refining prompts and instructions, and using real outputs and evaluations to shape what we ship.
  • Build what you design using code-based prototypes to explore ideas and align partners, shipping changes to production alongside engineering when it is the fastest path.
  • Design AI for multiplayer teams and enterprises by shaping the transparency, permissions, and admin controls that let organizations govern and roll out AI with confidence.
  • Drive ideas across teams by connecting work across our AI products (such as AI Teammates, AI Studio, and Dash) and platform teams, bringing partners along with working prototypes, clear narratives, and a strong point of view—while elevating fellow designers through critique, pairing, and mentorship.

About you

  • 8+ years of experience in product design, with a track record of leading design on complex products at a senior level
  • A portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design craft alongside a track record of shipping complex work at scale
  • Real-world experience designing and shipping AI products—such as agents, assistants, AI-powered automation, or generative features—including designing for model behavior, uncertainty, and failure in partnership with engineering, research, and product teams
  • Fluency with system and technical complexity, demonstrating the ability to reason about data models, permissions, integrations, and LLM constraints in behaviors and systems rather than just screens and flows
  • Hands-on proficiency with modern AI tools, regularly prototyping with LLMs, iterating on prompts, and using AI-assisted design and coding tools in your everyday workflow
  • Proven ability to lead work that spans multiple teams and drive alignment and execution without formal authority
  • Customer-centric problem solver who gets close to users, uncovers unspoken needs, and uses research and data evidence to back design decisions

title: Partner Program Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Channel and Ecosystems team is dedicated to accelerating Asana's growth and market reach through partnerships and fostering a thriving partner network. As a Partner Program Operations Manager, you will own the systems, workflows, and operational execution behind our partner journey—from application through onboarding. In this role, you will localize and scale the Global Partner Program, collaborating with cross-functional partners across our global offices to translate best practices into high-impact program improvements.

This role is based in our San Francisco, New York, or Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Administer our Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platform and Salesforce tooling, owning data integrity, user access, and ongoing platform enhancements.

  • Build and scale end-to-end workflows for partner onboarding, application, technical enablement, and certification.

  • Manage deal registration operations, incentive structures, and co-sell protections to drive timely partner rewards and compliance.

  • Own the regional adaptation and continuous evolution of the Global Partner Program by translating field feedback into scalable program releases.

  • Lead cross-functional operational rhythms with Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Product to align partner initiatives with company objectives.

  • Develop clear, accessible partner playbooks, incentive guides, and communication frameworks to support partner productivity.

  • Define and maintain key performance dashboards to evaluate partner ROI, analyze performance bottlenecks, and inform strategic decisions.

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • 3–6 years of partner operations or partner program management experience, preferably in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

  • Proven ability to take full ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives from strategy to execution.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of crafting clear operational documentation and partner resources.

  • Data-literate mindset with experience turning raw metrics into actionable operational insights.

  • Experience administering core partner tooling, including Salesforce (SFDC), PRM platforms, and BI tools (such as Tableau).

  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders, and work effectively across distributed global teams.
